stem: A sphere has diameter 6 cm. Taking π as 3, find its volume in cm³.
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 130 120" width="100%" style="max-width:130px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A sphere with diameter 6 cm marked right across through the centre"><title>A sphere with diameter 6 cm marked right across through the centre</title><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="46" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><ellipse cx="62" cy="60" rx="46" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#1d1d1b"/><line x1="16" y1="60" x2="108" y2="60" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2"/><text x="62" y="40" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">6 cm</text></svg>

misconceptions.message: You used 6 as the radius. Halve the diameter: r = 3.
That is 4/3 × 27. Now multiply by π, which is 3 here.

stem: A cone has radius 3 cm and perpendicular height 4 cm. Find its volume in terms of pi.
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 170 130" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A cone with radius 3 cm and perpendicular height 4 cm"><title>A cone with radius 3 cm and perpendicular height 4 cm</title><polygon points="80,12 30,100 130,100" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><ellipse cx="80" cy="100" rx="50" ry="14" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="80" y1="12" x2="80" y2="100" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/><circle cx="80" cy="100" r="2.5" fill="#1d1d1b"/><text x="84" y="84" fill="#2b5797" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" paint-order="stroke">4 cm</text><line x1="80" y1="100" x2="130" y2="100" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2"/><text x="105" y="126" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">3 cm</text></svg>
hint: A cone is not a sphere. Square the radius, times the height, divide by 3.
working: Not a sphere: this is volume of a cone. r² = 9. 9 × 4 = 36. 36 ÷ 3 = 12. V = 12 × π = 12π cm³.

misconceptions.message: You forgot the ÷ 3. A cone is a third of the cylinder round it.
You used the sphere's 4/3. A cone is ÷ 3 only, no × 4.
You dropped the π. Write your number, then pi.
